question: Which existing TFPT results constrain a common physical source, and can the existing marked CP channel preserve a fixed three-of-four sector?
scope: Exact finite M4 CP channel and its conditional correlated (16,4) group lift; uniform P/3 state for each rank-three projector. No identified W48 operator map or physical instrument selection.
summary_de: Gesamtsynthese bestehender positiver Ketten: M=41 ist an benannten Materieinhalt gebunden; k bestimmt P5. Neuer exakter CP-Kompatibilitätstest: jeder feste Rang-3-Unterraum hat für rho=P/3 Leakage1/9 nach einem Schritt,343/1458 nach sechs. Ein gespeicherter unitärer Zweig erhält die mittransportierte Marke. Physische Record-/Instrumentauswahl, W48-Operatorabbildung und gemeinsamer4D-Abschluss bleiben offen.
summary_en: Cross-domain synthesis of existing positive chains: M=41 is tied to declared matter content and k determines P5. Exact CP compatibility test: for rho=P/3 every fixed rank-three subspace has leakage1/9 after one step and343/1458 after six. A recorded unitary branch preserves the transported mark. Physical record/instrument selection, a W48 operator map and common4D closure remain open.
assumptions: Existing conditional unital CPTP channel Phi on M4 with orbit values1/3,2/3.
For the 64-dimensional consequence, use the existing correlated group lifts with the same Kraus weights, a conditional mathematical construction rather than a derived physical process.
Exact probability formula applies to the uniformly mixed P/3 state for each rank-three projector, not to every state in that subspace.
positive_results: Existing native character reconstructs the same P5 used by the charged response; transported characters reconstruct transported P5 under actual C/J.
Actual Clifford words imply a universal pure-state tensor identity and the exact n-step rank-three leakage formula.
Stored random-unitary branches preserve a simultaneously transported mark algebraically.
Existing low-Q reconstruction reduces the source-interaction question to specific operator responses, conditional on its full global hypotheses.
Existing M=10b1=40+1 and common-seed readout identities constrain several branches jointly; these are prior results, not new derivations.
kills: The existing unrecorded CP channel preserves an arbitrary fixed rank-three subspace; P/3 leaks1/9 after one step.
Reading the correlated same-weight (16,4) lift as a closed fixed16x3 sector: maximally mixed carrier rotations do not remove the leakage.
Treating the existing group lift alone as an already specified CP-effect to W48-current intertwiner.
leaves_open: Derive a common physical source selecting instrument, records, state, mark transport and time.
Construct the actual CP/readout to W48 operator map; no time-index to holonomy-parameter identification supplied.
Derive native C1=gW with g nonzero and C2=0 from that source and prove the global reconstruction hypotheses.
Common interacting chiral3+1D realization, controlled continuum, physical transfers, cosmological state and original metric normalization.
not_claimed: No full TFPT solution or T1-T8 gate closure.
No no-go for recorded instruments, different source dynamics or TFPT generally.
No globally novel Clifford/CP theorem claim; this is a project-specific composite compatibility test.
